description.describe_eh: The course is deigned to provide a practical in-depth knowledge of utilizing social media tools like email, blogs, podcasts, vodcasts, video, networking sites, and microblogs (Twitter) to engage with the target market and sell products/services. In particular, the course is to ensure that the knowledge and understanding can be applied in the practical construction of appropriate and realistic internet marketing strategies to help firms develop new markets.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
課堂參與及互動 40% 期中考or報告 30% 期末報告 30%
本課程的課程目標：
  1. 瞭解網路行銷的重要性和策略：學生能理解網路行銷在現代商業中的關鍵作用，並能運用相應的策略來推廣產品或服務。
  2. 掌握市場研究和目標客群定義能力：學生能進行市場研究，準確定義目標客群，並制定適切的行銷策略。
  3. 瞭解創業基本原則：學生將獲得有關創業的基本知識，包括商業模式、價值主張和創業過程等，以促進創業思維和創新能力的發展。
  4. 運用學習到的知識和技能進行實踐：學生將通過案例分析、團隊項目和個人任務等實際操作，將所學知識和技能應用於網路行銷和創業實務中。
Grading Criteria
Class Participation & Interaction – 40%
Midterm Exam or Report – 30%
Final Report – 30%
Course Objectives
Understand the Importance and Strategies of Online Marketing
Students will recognize the key role of online marketing in modern business and apply relevant strategies to promote products or services.
Develop Market Research and Target Audience Identification Skills
Students will conduct market research, accurately define target audiences, and formulate effective marketing strategies.
Learn the Fundamentals of Entrepreneurship
Students will gain essential knowledge about entrepreneurship, including business models, value propositions, and startup processes, fostering entrepreneurial thinking and innovation.
Apply Acquired Knowledge and Skills in Practice
Through case studies, team projects, and individual assignments, students will apply their knowledge and skills to real-world online marketing and entrepreneurship scenarios.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
從企業經營與策略的角度，融合個案、理論、實務，並以三大篇16章解說電子商務與網路行銷的樣貌，第一篇「電子商務基礎篇」，包括電子商務的基本概念、Web 3.0與雲端商務、商業模式、基礎建設、付費系統、安全機制、倫理與法律議題；第二篇「電子商務策略篇」著眼於不同企業型態之網路經營策略，以及從策略到行動所需之數位化轉型；第三篇「網路行銷篇」先探討網路行銷的基本概念與網路行銷規劃，接著介紹網路行銷組合與行銷工具，最後則探討行動商務與跨境電商。
From the perspective of business management and strategy, this course integrates case studies, theories, and practical applications, presenting e-commerce and online marketing through three major sections across 16 chapters.

Fundamentals of E-Commerce

Covers key topics such as basic e-commerce concepts, Web 3.0 and cloud commerce, business models, infrastructure, payment systems, security mechanisms, and ethical and legal issues.

E-Commerce Strategies

Focuses on online business strategies for different types of enterprises and the digital transformation required to move from strategy to execution.

Online Marketing

Begins with fundamental concepts and planning, followed by marketing mix strategies and tools, and concludes with mobile commerce and cross-border e-commerce.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies

This course integrates case studies, theories, and practical applications from the perspective of business management and strategy. Each chapter explains different aspects of marketing, focusing on marketing management strategies for various business types and the digital transformation required to move from strategy to execution.

In the later "Internet Marketing" section, the course will first explore fundamental concepts and planning in internet marketing. It will then introduce internet marketing mix strategies and tools, followed by discussions on mobile commerce and cross-border e-commerce.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
本課程不僅有學術理論式的內容支撐，也不同於一般市面上網路行銷工具教學。
課程旨在培養「網路整合行銷」專業人才，並且從中探討品牌塑造及品牌創新發展。
依課程進度需求將不定時補充資料  例如：數位時代、天下、遠見等即時性的雜誌時事案例;
依課程進度補充網路、社群、新市場開發等相關影片賞析。
This course is not only supported by academic theories but also differs from typical online marketing tool training available in the market.

The primary goal is to cultivate professionals in integrated online marketing, with a strong focus on brand building and brand innovation.

Additional materials will be provided as needed, including real-time case studies from publications such as Digital Age, CommonWealth, and Global Views Monthly. Supplementary videos on internet marketing, social media, and new market development will also be included based on course progress.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
This course is not only supported by academic theories but also differs from typical marketing tool training available in the market.

The primary goal is to cultivate marketing professionals, with a strong focus on brand building and brand innovation.

Additional materials will be provided as needed, including real-time case studies from publications such as Digital Age, CommonWealth, and Global Views Monthly. Supplementary videos on internet marketing, social media, and new market development will also be included based on course progress.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. 在專題報告，老師將會觀察及審閱同學們的學習任務，鼓勵與同學合作，以完成書面報告、或專題實作及發表。
  2. 組成學習或閱讀小組可能是學習的有效途徑。但是，禁止搭便車行為，每位同學都要有獨立學習及個人實作的能力，十分不建議只會單一專長（例如：只會寫企劃書，只會設計作圖，只會拍照）每位同學都被期望是能獨立完成一份企劃書。
  3. 如果企劃案或是行銷素材有侵犯到智財權，您的作業將為零分。將依學生獎懲辦法提送獎懲委員會處分，請格外小心。
  4. 如果你的成績及作業感到惶恐，請不要輕易放棄。可以與我聯繫，我們可以協商找出可幫助您完成學業的方案。一旦作弊，要協商任何問題都為時已晚。
  5. 行銷系系務會議規範，缺曠課時數超過12小時，則該堂課程成績將會不及格。
Project Report Guidelines & Attendance Policy
In the project report, the instructor will observe and review students' learning tasks, encouraging collaboration to complete written reports, project implementations, and presentations.
Forming study or reading groups can be an effective learning approach. However, free-riding is strictly prohibited—each student must demonstrate independent learning and hands-on skills. Specialization in only one skill (e.g., only writing proposals, only designing graphics, or only taking photos) is strongly discouraged. Every student is expected to be capable of independently completing a full marketing proposal.
If a marketing plan or materials infringe on intellectual property rights, the assignment will receive a zero and will be submitted to the disciplinary committee in accordance with student conduct regulations. Please be extremely careful.
If you feel overwhelmed by your grades or assignments, do not give up easily. You may contact the instructor to discuss possible solutions to help you complete the course. However, if academic dishonesty is detected, it will be too late for any negotiation.
Attendance Policy
According to the Marketing Department Meeting Regulations, students who accumulate more than 12 hours of unexcused absences will fail the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Project Report Guidelines
In the project report, the instructor will observe and review students' learning tasks, encouraging collaboration among classmates to complete written reports, project implementations, and presentations.
Forming study or reading groups can be an effective way to learn. However, free-riding behavior is strictly prohibited—each student must demonstrate independent learning and practical skills. It is strongly discouraged for students to specialize in only one area (e.g., only writing proposals, only designing graphics, or only taking photos). Every student is expected to be capable of independently completing a proposal.
If your project proposal or marketing materials infringe on intellectual property rights, your assignment will receive a score of zero. Additionally, your case will be submitted to the disciplinary committee according to student conduct regulations. Please be extremely cautious.
If you feel anxious about your grades or assignments, do not give up easily. You may contact me, and we can discuss possible solutions to help you complete your coursework.
However, if you engage in academic dishonesty, it will be too late to negotiate any issues.

Fundamentals of E-Commerce

Covers key topics such as basic e-commerce concepts, Web 3.0 and cloud commerce, business models, infrastructure, payment systems, security mechanisms, and ethical and legal issues.

E-Commerce Strategies

Focuses on online business strategies for different types of enterprises and the digital transformation required to move from strategy to execution.

Online Marketing

Begins with fundamental concepts and planning, followed by marketing mix strategies and tools, and concludes with mobile commerce and cross-border e-commerce.
policy.course_pol_en:
Course Policies

This course integrates case studies, theories, and practical applications from the perspective of business management and strategy. Each chapter explains different aspects of marketing, focusing on marketing management strategies for various business types and the digital transformation required to move from strategy to execution.

In the later "Internet Marketing" section, the course will first explore fundamental concepts and planning in internet marketing. It will then introduce internet marketing mix strategies and tools, followed by discussions on mobile commerce and cross-border e-commerce.
policy.course_rem:
本課程不僅有學術理論式的內容支撐，也不同於一般市面上網路行銷工具教學。
課程旨在培養「網路整合行銷」專業人才，並且從中探討品牌塑造及品牌創新發展。
依課程進度需求將不定時補充資料  例如：數位時代、天下、遠見等即時性的雜誌時事案例;
依課程進度補充網路、社群、新市場開發等相關影片賞析。
This course is not only supported by academic theories but also differs from typical online marketing tool training available in the market.

The primary goal is to cultivate professionals in integrated online marketing, with a strong focus on brand building and brand innovation.

Additional materials will be provided as needed, including real-time case studies from publications such as Digital Age, CommonWealth, and Global Views Monthly. Supplementary videos on internet marketing, social media, and new market development will also be included based on course progress.

policy.ais_meno:
1. 在專題報告，老師將會觀察及審閱同學們的學習任務，鼓勵與同學合作，以完成書面報告、或專題實作及發表。
  2. 組成學習或閱讀小組可能是學習的有效途徑。但是，禁止搭便車行為，每位同學都要有獨立學習及個人實作的能力，十分不建議只會單一專長（例如：只會寫企劃書，只會設計作圖，只會拍照）每位同學都被期望是能獨立完成一份企劃書。
  3. 如果企劃案或是行銷素材有侵犯到智財權，您的作業將為零分。將依學生獎懲辦法提送獎懲委員會處分，請格外小心。
  4. 如果你的成績及作業感到惶恐，請不要輕易放棄。可以與我聯繫，我們可以協商找出可幫助您完成學業的方案。一旦作弊，要協商任何問題都為時已晚。
  5. 行銷系系務會議規範，缺曠課時數超過12小時，則該堂課程成績將會不及格。
Project Report Guidelines & Attendance Policy
In the project report, the instructor will observe and review students' learning tasks, encouraging collaboration to complete written reports, project implementations, and presentations.
Forming study or reading groups can be an effective learning approach. However, free-riding is strictly prohibited—each student must demonstrate independent learning and hands-on skills. Specialization in only one skill (e.g., only writing proposals, only designing graphics, or only taking photos) is strongly discouraged. Every student is expected to be capable of independently completing a full marketing proposal.
If a marketing plan or materials infringe on intellectual property rights, the assignment will receive a zero and will be submitted to the disciplinary committee in accordance with student conduct regulations. Please be extremely careful.
If you feel overwhelmed by your grades or assignments, do not give up easily. You may contact the instructor to discuss possible solutions to help you complete the course. However, if academic dishonesty is detected, it will be too late for any negotiation.
Attendance Policy
According to the Marketing Department Meeting Regulations, students who accumulate more than 12 hours of unexcused absences will fail the course.
policy.ais_meno_en:
Project Report Guidelines
In the project report, the instructor will observe and review students' learning tasks, encouraging collaboration among classmates to complete written reports, project implementations, and presentations.
Forming study or reading groups can be an effective way to learn. However, free-riding behavior is strictly prohibited—each student must demonstrate independent learning and practical skills. It is strongly discouraged for students to specialize in only one area (e.g., only writing proposals, only designing graphics, or only taking photos). Every student is expected to be capable of independently completing a proposal.
If your project proposal or marketing materials infringe on intellectual property rights, your assignment will receive a score of zero. Additionally, your case will be submitted to the disciplinary committee according to student conduct regulations. Please be extremely cautious.
If you feel anxious about your grades or assignments, do not give up easily. You may contact me, and we can discuss possible solutions to help you complete your coursework.
However, if you engage in academic dishonesty, it will be too late to negotiate any issues.
